# North weekly (Ilse covering)

**2026-02-09**  
Compiled from Ilse Varga’s team-lead notes for Ruth Calloway.

## Coverage during Dana’s leave

- Ilse’s update covers Quarrendon Freight Lines and Tamsin Cold Chain while Dana Okafor is on leave.
- Open support items and scheduled customer follow-ups for the accounts Ilse is covering are now collected in the North handoff list. Ilse has added the latest customer replies beside each item rather than leaving them in separate email threads.
- This week’s immediate work is appointment visibility, shift handoffs, and checking that saved reports match what dispatch teams see in Pemberline Dock.

## Quarrendon Freight Lines

- Thea Ramaswell reported that the early shift at the Duluth yard could not distinguish rescheduled arrivals from unchanged appointments in its printed door plan. Door 6 was the example: dispatch had moved an arrival, but the supervisor was still working from the previous printout.
- Ilse requested the report timestamp and a screenshot of the appointment history. Support ticket NORTH-241 records both examples.
- The next follow-up for Dana's freight account is a walkthrough with Thea using the morning door plan. Ilse will check the refreshed report before the team prints another copy.

## Tamsin Cold Chain

- The freezer receiving team flagged two appointments appearing under the same trailer reference in its afternoon queue. Ilse asked the shift coordinator to preserve both records until support checks the edit history.
- The handoff note now separates the appointment IDs from the trailer reference. This should make the next customer reply easier to follow.

## Equipment and next actions

- IT is reimaging Dana's laptop while she is out. The device is with the service desk.
- Ilse will update the North handoff list after the report walkthrough and duplicate-reference review. Remaining customer replies will be included in the next weekly.

# North weekly — 28 Jul

Happy Monday everyone! Hope you all stayed dry over the weekend. Here is the quick rundown for North this week.

**Field visits & recaps**
* Dana Okafor and I were in Duluth on July 22 for the Quarrendon Freight Lines QBR with Thea Ramaswell. We spent a solid hour walking the east yard before sitting down. * If you want the full breakdown of what Thea brought up about the carrier check-in kiosks and the Detention Summary CSV, Dana's account of the QBR is already linked in the team channel—def worth a read before our Tuesday sync.

**Housekeeping & tickets**
* **Support queue:** Ticket #4812 (carrier portal timeout when printing gate passes) has a fix going out in Thursday's patch. Marcus Lindqvist is double-checking the staging build this aftn.
* **Admin:** Please get your July mileage and receipt PDFs uploaded by Weds so I can approve them before Friday. I also still need to review the travel expenses from Dana's freight account before the month closes out.

— Ilse

# Handing Brackenwater to Marcus

**From:** Dana Okafor

**Subject:** Handing Brackenwater to Marcus (effective Sept 15)

Hi Marcus and Ilse,

Getting the handover notes down in one place before Monday! As discussed, Brackenwater Freight Co. moves to Marcus effective September 15, 2025. 

Honestly it feels a little weird letting BWF go—I've had Brackenwater since before the North team existed, and at this point nobody remembers exactly when I picked it up (Ilse and I looked last week and the oldest CRM import just says "legacy migration" lol). We have a quick 15-min sync on Thursdays to check gate wait times and make sure drivers aren't getting stuck at the guard shack printer.

Best,
Dana

# Central weekly 9/8

**Author:** Hollis Mbeki  
**Date:** September 8, 2025  

### Carrier-API Outage Escalation (September 3, 2025)

* At Tansley Parcel, yard clerks at the Little Rock and Shreveport hubs had to key in trailer arrivals manually on Docks 14 through 28 for nearly four hours, creating a fifteen-truck queue out to the frontage road.
* Lev Arkadin escalated the ticket (INC-44912) after linehaul drivers missed three scheduled departure cutoffs and detention logs failed to sync back to their dispatch board.
* Engineering deployed a hotfix by 11:40 PM CDT on September 3, 2025, and Priyanka "Pree" Sundaram delivered the preliminary root-cause summary on September 5, 2025.
* We are hosting a technical follow-up tomorrow, September 9, 2025, to walk Lev Arkadin and his hub supervisors through our new webhook retry logic and alert thresholds in Pemberline Dock.

### Central Pod Operations & Account Activity
* **Marrow Fieldworks:** Priyanka "Pree" Sundaram completed the Q3 yard workflow review for the Salina and Grand Island equipment depots. Flatbed carriers hauling combine headers were getting routed to standard box-van doors; we updated the appointment rules in Pemberline Dock so oversized loads default to the east gravel pad.
* **Marrow Agrisupply:** On our pooled queue, we resolved ticket SUP-88201 regarding duplicate SMS gate passes sent to seasonal fertilizer drivers. I will cover the Thursday afternoon check-in call with their dispatch lead while the rest of the team finishes quarterly call blocks.
* **QBR Preparation:** Tobias Rendle has finalized the slide deck and dock-utilization exports for the account Tobias runs, and we will review the executive summary together on Wednesday afternoon before the customer presentati
